correctness.rationale: The claim is reconstructed from the source general q-Kronecker theorem and hook-length lower bound. For the staircase, the exact ratio H_n/H_{n-1}=(2n-1)!! and d_n-d_{n-1}=n reduce the proof to standard Stirling expansions. Division by the exact composition length (q+2)n gives c(q). The derivative calculation proves that c decreases for q>=4, and an elementary logarithm comparison gives c(4)>c(3). The finite verifier checks only arithmetic identities and is not used as an infinite proof.
